results.title: PRESERVE: Prefetching Model Weights and KV-Cache in Distributed LLM Serving
results.summary: Proposes a framework that prefetches model weights and KV-cache from off-chip HBM to on-chip cache during inter-device communication in distributed LLM serving, reporting up to 1.6x end-to-end speedup. Directly addresses KV-cache transfer and prefetch in multi-accelerator inference.

results.title: AttentionPredictor: Temporal Patterns Matter for KV Cache Compression
results.summary: Introduces a lightweight convolution model that predicts attention patterns to compress the KV cache, and proposes the first cross-token critical cache prefetching framework that hides token estimation and transfer latency during decoding. Covers both compression and prefetch.

results.title: Accelerating LLM Inference Throughput via Asynchronous KV Cache Prefetching
results.summary: An L2-cache-oriented asynchronous KV-cache prefetching method that overlaps computation with memory access to break HBM bandwidth bottlenecks, achieving 2.15x attention kernel efficiency and up to 1.97x end-to-end throughput on NVIDIA H20 GPUs. A primary source on KV-cache prefetch placement into on-chip cache.

results.title: KVTC: KV Cache Transform Coding for Compact Storage in LLM Inference
results.summary: A lightweight transform coder using PCA-based decorrelation, adaptive quantization, and entropy coding to compress KV caches up to 20x (40x+ in some cases) while preserving reasoning and long-context accuracy. A primary KV-cache compression method.

results.title: KV Cache Optimization Strategies for Scalable and Efficient LLM Inference
results.summary: A systematic review organizing KV-cache techniques into five directions (eviction, compression, hybrid memory/placement, novel attention, combinations) and mapping them to seven deployment scenarios. Useful primary survey spanning compression and placement trade-offs.

results.title: PipeMax: Enhancing Offline LLM Inference on Commodity GPU Servers
results.summary: A high-throughput inference system integrating pipeline parallelism with KV-cache offloading of inactive batches, coordinating computation with data movement to expand effective GPU memory and reaching up to 2.51x throughput over vLLM. Relevant to KV-cache placement and prefetch/offload scheduling.

results.title: Efficient Zero-Copy KV Cache Offloading for Long-Context LLMs (DirectKV)
results.summary: DirectKV, presented at OSDI 2026, is a system for zero-copy KV-cache decoding that reduces GPU memory pressure when serving long-context LLMs. A primary systems source on KV-cache offloading/placement.

results.title: LMCache Documentation
results.summary: Official documentation for LMCache, describing KV-cache transfer between prefill and decode workers over NVLink, RDMA, or TCP via transport layers such as NIXL. Primary source for KV-cache transfer mechanisms in disaggregated serving.

results.title: Awesome-KV-Cache-Optimization
results.summary: A curated, actively maintained index of KV-cache optimization research organized by storage location, transfer, and structural compression, serving as a navigation hub for compression/transfer/placement literature.
